destination.title: Moduli stabilization and compatibility of vacuum ingredients
destination.question: Which source-specific ingredients can stabilize compactification moduli, and under what geometric, gauge, matter-sector and vacuum-energy conditions can those ingredients coexist?
destination.summary: A shared stabilization direction is needed across the warped, flux, condensate and fluxless settings. It does not require every construction to generate a hierarchy, break supersymmetry or produce positive vacuum energy.

systems: Associated supergravity constructions with explicitly stated compactification assumptions
targets: Admissibility and compatibility of stabilization ingredients
Conditional vacuum energy and hierarchy outcomes
regimes: Supersymmetric and broken vacua at their stated approximation orders
assumptions: Flux constraints, zero modes, chirality, hidden sectors and Kähler data are source-specific
A nonperturbative superpotential or positive energy contribution does not establish a complete stabilized vacuum
Local or effective constructions need separate compact-completion and control checks
conventions: No common potential normalization or modulus definition is inferred
includes: Compatibility tests and unsuccessful proposed uplifts
excludes: Universal positive vacuum energy or phenomenological success

sources.title: Low Energy Supersymmetry from Non-Geometry

evidence.text: Can non-geometric fluxes generate an exponentially small gravitino mass while retaining a high string scale and stabilizing all moduli, by first constructing perturbative W=0 Minkowski vacua and then introducing small non-perturbative effects?

sources.title: Low Energy Supersymmetry from Non-Geometry

evidence.text: Can a non-geometric flux sector generate the small constants needed by an ISS supersymmetry-breaking sector while stabilizing its gauge-coupling modulus perturbatively?

sources.title: Moduli stabilization in (string) model building: Gauge fluxes and loops

evidence.text: Can gauge-flux D-terms, a Scherk-Schwarz source for a constant superpotential, and gaugino condensation consistently stabilize the dilaton and volume moduli, and do flux-induced quantum corrections preserve the resulting minimum?

sources.title: Stabilizing moduli with thermal matter and nonperturbative effects

evidence.text: Can gaugino-condensation stabilization of the dilaton coexist with radion stabilization by enhanced-symmetry momentum/winding strings, without their combined dynamics destabilizing either modulus? The paper presents a preliminary answer under simplifying approximations.

sources.title: F-term Uplift in Heterotic M-theory

evidence.text: Can vector bundle moduli provide sufficient F-term uplift to stabilize supersymmetry-breaking Minkowski or de Sitter vacua in heterotic M-theory, including when the tree-level superpotential is constant?

sources.title: A sufficient condition for de Sitter vacua in type IIB string theory

evidence.text: Can Kähler uplifting yield an analytic sufficient condition, expressed through flux and compactification data, for metastable de Sitter vacua with small positive vacuum energy, spontaneously broken supersymmetry and stabilized moduli?

sources.title: De Sitter Vacua from Nonperturbative Flux Compactifications

evidence.text: Can a moduli-dependent nonperturbative superpotential stabilize the modeled type IIB moduli simultaneously in a metastable de Sitter vacuum, without a separate explicitly supersymmetry-breaking uplift?

sources.title: De Sitter Vacua from a D-term Generated Racetrack Uplift

evidence.text: Can a D-term relation between two small Kähler moduli generate an F-term racetrack uplift from an LVS AdS minimum to metastable de Sitter, while keeping the D-term potential zero and avoiding additional warping or dilaton suppression?

sources.title: Single-step de Sitter vacua from nonperturbative effects with matter

evidence.text: Can coupled closed-string moduli and matter fields produce single-step metastable de Sitter stabilization through a pure F-term potential, without assuming that the axiodilaton and complex structure were already stabilized at a higher scale?

sources.title: De Sitter from T-branes

evidence.text: Can hidden-sector F-term uplifting induced by D-term stabilization be understood by expanding a higher-dimensional D7 theory around a supersymmetric T-brane background, and can the resulting contribution support de Sitter LVS minima?

sources.title: de Sitter vacua from an anomalous gauge symmetry

evidence.text: Can magnetic-flux and anomaly-induced FI terms, a moduli-dependent gauge kinetic function and a gauge-invariant nonperturbative superpotential stabilize moduli in metastable de Sitter or Minkowski vacua without additional low-energy uplift fields?

sources.title: A New Class of de Sitter Vacua in Type IIB Large Volume Compactifications

evidence.text: Can the Large Volume Scenario support perturbatively metastable de Sitter vacua through small flux-induced supersymmetry breaking in the complex-structure/axio-dilaton sector, without an additional uplift sector?

sources.title: Perturbative moduli stabilisation in type IIB/F-theory framework

evidence.text: Can logarithmic perturbative corrections to the Kähler potential, combined with magnetic D7-brane D-terms, stabilize geometric Kähler moduli at a de Sitter vacuum without nonperturbative superpotential effects?

sources.title: Uplifting Runaways

evidence.text: A warped throat must retain its conifold deformation while supplying a small uplift. In a compact embedding, fluxes and the ultraviolet gluing surface make deformation changes physical, rather than removable solely by rescaling noncompact coordinates.

sources.title: Swampland Variations on a Theme by KKLT

evidence.text: Can flux stabilization near a conifold produce a warped compactification whose conifold and Kähler moduli admit a consistent four-dimensional effective description?

sources.title: Uplifting Anti-D6-brane

evidence.text: Can a type IIA STU effective model stabilize all moduli in a supersymmetric AdS minimum using only six-form flux and nonperturbative terms, then admit a metastable de Sitter uplift from anti-D6-branes?

sources.title: Quantum Log-Corrections to Swampland Conjectures

evidence.text: Can a strongly warped throat generate exponentially small W0 with a better controlled light tower than the toroidal construction?

sources.title: KKLT and the Swampland Conjectures

evidence.text: Can the conifold and volume fields be described reliably when a long, strongly warped throat develops?

sources.title: The Octagon at large M

evidence.text: Could a throat with dynamical supersymmetry breaking replace an explicit anti-D-brane ingredient in a compact de Sitter construction, possibly combining moduli stabilization and supersymmetry breaking in one construction?

sources.title: Heterotic de Sitter beyond modular symmetry

evidence.text: Which branches of two-modulus heterotic orbifold effective theories forbid metastable de Sitter vacua, and can inherently stringy corrections of strength O(exp(-1/gs)) evade those restrictions while preserving T-duality?

sources.title: Heterotic string theory on nonKahler manifolds with H flux and gaugino condensate

evidence.text: Can the heterotic H-flux balance against non-Kähler geometry be combined with the flux/gaugino-condensate balance to obtain supersymmetry-breaking vacua with zero cosmological constant, and what effective superpotential would describe them?

sources.title: Heterotic moduli stabilization with fractional Chern-Simons invariants

evidence.text: Can small fractional H-flux induced by Wilson lines balance hidden-sector gaugino condensation to stabilize heterotic dilaton, complex-structure and Kähler moduli at weak coupling and large radius?

sources.title: Gaugino condensation and SUSY breakdown

evidence.text: How can hidden-sector gaugino condensation, together with higher-dimensional antisymmetric-tensor flux, produce four-dimensional supersymmetry breaking, control vacuum energy, and contribute to moduli stabilization?

sources.title: Moduli potentials in string compactifications with fluxes: Mapping the discretuum

evidence.text: Can flux compactifications stabilize all moduli through F-terms while producing broken supersymmetry, a small nonnegative cosmological constant, and a hierarchy within weak coupling and large volume? Are the resulting vacua cosmologically viable?

sources.title: De Sitter vacua from heterotic M theory

evidence.text: Can open membrane instantons and hidden-boundary gaugino condensation generate positive-energy, supersymmetry-breaking vacua while stabilizing the orbifold length and charged matter in heterotic M-theory?

sources.title: De Sitter vacua from uplifting D-terms in effective supergravities from realistic strings

evidence.text: Can an anomalous U(1) D-term consistently uplift AdS minima to de Sitter or Minkowski vacua once gauge invariance, charged matter and the supergravity relation between F- and D-terms are included?

sources.title: Stabilizing moduli with a positive cosmological constant in heterotic M-theory

evidence.text: Can anti-five-branes uplift stabilized heterotic M-theory vacua to metastable, supersymmetry-breaking vacua with a small positive cosmological constant, while preserving observable-bundle slope stability?

sources.title: S-track stabilization of heterotic de Sitter vacua

evidence.text: Can M5-instantons stabilize the heterotic M-theory volume modulus S together with the interval modulus T, producing de Sitter vacua with spontaneous supersymmetry breaking without multiple gaugino condensates?

sources.title: Moduli Stabilization in Type IIB Orientifolds (II)

evidence.text: Which resolved toroidal type IIB orientifolds permit closed-string moduli stabilization in the large-radius KKLT framework, and what obstructs a controlled uplift when complex-structure moduli are absent?

sources.title: Gaugino Condensates and D-terms from D7-branes

evidence.text: Can flux-induced D-terms on one D7 stack coexist consistently with a Kähler-modulus-dependent gaugino-condensation superpotential on a different stack, as required by proposed D-term uplifts?

sources.title: Low Energy Supersymmetry from Non-Geometry

evidence.text: Combine a world-volume-flux D-term with non-perturbative stabilization, then minimize over charged open fields. A viable uplift requires a surviving positive contribution at the small vacuum-energy scale rather than automatic D-flatness or a Planck-scale energy.

sources.title: Moduli stabilization in (string) model building: Gauge fluxes and loops

evidence.text: Covariant-derivative commutators are mapped to harmonic-oscillator algebra to obtain charged spectra; the index theorem supplies the flux-dependent degeneracy. A four-dimensional one-loop effective-potential calculation then gives the Casimir energy.

sources.title: Stabilizing moduli with thermal matter and nonperturbative effects

evidence.text: Construct the four-dimensional N=1 supergravity potential using K(S)=−ln(S+S̄), K(T)=−3ln(T+T̄) and W=MP³(C−A exp(−a0 S)). Use its no-scale structure, expand near a dilaton minimum, and lift the approximate potential to ten-dimensional Einstein variables.

sources.title: F-term Uplift in Heterotic M-theory

evidence.text: Split the F-term potential into V0 and positive bundle-dependent square terms δV0. Uplift requires kα^I∂IW+∂αW≠0 for at least one bundle modulus α, and therefore entails supersymmetry breaking.

sources.title: A sufficient condition for de Sitter vacua in type IIB string theory

evidence.text: Expanding in ξ̂/V̂ and Ae^(−at)/|W0| reduces the single-modulus potential to a negative exponential term plus a positive inverse-power term. The allowed window is bounded by simultaneous V=V′=0 at its lower edge and V′=V″=0 at its upper edge.

sources.title: De Sitter Vacua from Nonperturbative Flux Compactifications

evidence.text: A genetic algorithm searches the six supersymmetry-breaking parameters, requiring positive potential and every modeled scalar mass eigenvalue positive. Five searches optimize the supersymmetry-breaking ratio or hierarchies between RR, NSNS and nonperturbative coefficients.

sources.title: Gaugino condensation and nonperturbative superpotentials in flux compactifications

evidence.text: Can flux stabilize coincident D7 branes at enhanced gauge symmetry while lifting their matter, thereby generating a gaugino-condensation superpotential for Kähler moduli? How does this affect arithmetic-genus restrictions and proposals with a single Kähler modulus?

sources.title: An M theory Solution to the Hierarchy Problem

evidence.text: Can strong hidden-sector gauge dynamics in fluxless G₂ compactifications stabilize moduli while generating the electroweak–Planck hierarchy, and what supersymmetry-breaking soft spectrum follows?

destination.title: Effective actions and controlled compactification descriptions
destination.question: How should compactification actions, localized-source terms and retained-field descriptions be constructed, and when do higher-dimensional constraints or quantum corrections permit their controlled use?
destination.summary: This method direction connects kinetic reductions, condensate actions and quantum-control tests without equating their dimensions, field content or approximation schemes.

targets: Effective actions, field coordinates and kinetic terms
Ordering corrections and assessing truncation control
regimes: Classical, quantum-corrected and bounded fermionic truncations
Static and evolving backgrounds where explicitly analyzed
assumptions: Retained fields and omitted terms require separate justification in each setting
Matching an effective coupling is distinct from exhibiting a controlled vacuum
An obstruction in an examined ansatz is not a universal obstruction
conventions: Dimensional reduction, metric normalization and coupling conventions remain source-specific
includes: Premise checks and source-local failures of control
excludes: A complete non-Abelian brane action inferred from a restricted truncation
A general de Sitter no-go theorem

sources.title: Dynamics of Warped Flux Compactifications

evidence.text: How can type IIB compactification yield a four-dimensional effective action that includes strong warping, moduli and light KK excitations, while respecting ten-dimensional constraint equations?

sources.title: Kinetic terms in warped compactifications

evidence.text: How should kinetic terms of compactification moduli be computed with warping and gauge constraints, and what does the resulting prescription imply for the complex deformation modulus of a warped conifold?

sources.title: The Universal Kahler Modulus in Warped Compactifications

evidence.text: What are the correct spacetime-dependent ten-dimensional wavefunctions and four-dimensional kinetic theory of the universal Kähler modulus and its axion in warped compactifications, including strong warping and finite modulus motion?

sources.title: Warping the Kähler potential of F-theory/IIB flux compactifications

evidence.text: How does nonconstant warping determine the low-energy Kähler potential, holomorphic coordinates and kinetic terms of F-theory/IIB flux compactifications, including Kähler, universal, mobile-D3 and axionic moduli?

sources.title: The effective action of warped M-theory reductions with higher derivative terms — part I

evidence.text: Determine the three-dimensional two-derivative action for Kähler metric deformations and three-form vector modes in warped M-theory compactifications, including higher-curvature corrections and the deformation dependence of the warp factor.

sources.title: Quantum Corrections and the de Sitter Swampland Conjecture

evidence.text: Which fluxes and quantum corrections can support an assumed type IIB de Sitter metric, and can those ingredients remain time independent?

sources.title: The Tension between 10D Supergravity and dS Uplifts

evidence.text: How are volume, warping, fluxes and external curvature normalized? The single Kähler modulus is ρ=θ+iσ with σ=L⁴. The curvature analysis uses a metric parametrization without the explicit volume factors displayed in the dimensional-reduction review.

sources.title: On brane gaugino condensates in 10d

evidence.text: Determine whether localized gaugino condensation admits a finite ten-dimensional flux description consistent with four-dimensional supergravity. The issue matters for moduli stabilization and positivity arguments sensitive to localized brane contributions.

sources.title: de Sitter vacua in the string landscape

evidence.text: Can evolving internal geometry and fluxes support IIB four-dimensional de Sitter isometries with constant Newton's constant? The paper studies this through an M-theory uplift and quantum-correction hierarchies.

sources.title: de Sitter vacua in the string landscape

evidence.text: Can evolving internal shape and fluxes restore quantum control while keeping the effective gravitational coefficient constant? The paper compares constant-volume and varying-volume branches with a fixed type IIB coupling.

sources.title: de Sitter vacua in the string landscape

evidence.text: Can time-dependent compactification geometry, fluxes and quantum corrections support four-dimensional de Sitter isometries with constant Newton coupling and a controlled effective field theory, despite obstructions found for time-independent internal configurations?

sources.title: How a four-dimensional de Sitter solution remains outside the swampland

evidence.text: Can internal time dependence and quantum corrections support four-dimensional type-IIB de Sitter solutions with an effective field theory, and why does the corresponding time-independent ansatz fail?

sources.title: de Sitter Vacua in the String Landscape: La Petite Version

evidence.text: Can a type IIB compactification with an external de Sitter metric retain an effective description when its internal warp factors and fluxes evolve, while the axion, type IIB dilaton and four-dimensional Newton constant remain fixed?

sources.title: Completing the D7-brane local gaugino action

evidence.text: Can the divergent quartic gaugino interaction generated by integrating out bulk three-form flux near D7-branes be renormalized using a local, covariant brane action that reduces to the expected 4d N=1 supergravity gaugino couplings?

sources.title: Dimensional reduction and Kähler metric for metric moduli in imaginary self-dual flux

evidence.text: What four-dimensional kinetic action and moduli-space metric follow directly from ten-dimensional equations for geometric Kähler moduli and unstabilized complex-structure/axiodilaton directions in warped ISD-flux compactifications?

sources.title: Dynamics of Warped Flux Compactifications

evidence.text: Expand the ten-dimensional action to second order, include the Gibbons–Hawking–York term, integrate internal wavefunctions and impose constraints. Handle five-form self-duality by eliminating half its four-dimensional degrees of freedom and doubling the five-form and Chern–Simons coefficients.

sources.title: Kinetic terms in warped compactifications

evidence.text: For the conifold, rewrite the metric integral as a boundary term. Replace the full throat by a hard-wall approximation, solve radial compensator equations near the infrared boundary, and fix their normalization by matching to the KS fluctuation norm.

sources.title: The Universal Kahler Modulus in Warped Compactifications

evidence.text: Apply an imported Hamiltonian dimensional-reduction formalism: compensators act as Lagrange multipliers imposing momentum or Gauss-law constraints, and canonical momenta define gauge-invariant fluctuations and their kinetic inner product.

sources.title: Warping the Kähler potential of F-theory/IIB flux compactifications

evidence.text: Uses holomorphy of supersymmetric Euclidean D3 instanton actions to identify real parts of chiral coordinates from their on-shell DBI actions. This avoids directly reconstructing globally problematic Chern–Simons potentials; vertical M5 instantons provide the dual interpretation.

sources.title: The effective action of warped M-theory reductions with higher derivative terms — part I

evidence.text: Insert the perturbed ansatz into the eleven-dimensional action, reduce using internal total derivatives, Schouten and Bianchi identities, and perform an external Weyl rescaling to Einstein frame. The authors report computer-assisted tensor manipulations using xAct.

sources.title: Quantum Corrections and the de Sitter Swampland Conjecture

evidence.text: Specify the kinetic metric, compute the directional derivative, apply the dual-norm inequality, and divide by the displacement norm. This transfers a premise rather than generating a universal positive constant.

sources.title: de Sitter vacua in the string landscape

evidence.text: Can a warped string compactification support positive four-dimensional curvature with controlled quantum corrections? The paper asks whether external deformations suffice or whether internal geometry and fluxes must also evolve.

destination.title: Mediation, soft spectra and hidden–visible transmission
destination.question: How do stabilization, localization and hidden-sector dynamics determine supersymmetry-breaking transmission and soft spectra, and what follows for flavor suppression, gauge mediation and moduli cosmology?
destination.summary: A cross-batch direction connects the admitted mediation and sequestering questions while preserving warped, LARGE-volume and G2 assumptions and their different phenomenological targets.

systems: Fluxless G2 models and other specified supergravity settings
targets: Relative mediation strengths and soft spectra
Suppression or transmission of flavor-sensitive interactions
Cosmological consequences of the resulting moduli and breaking scales
regimes: Joint stabilization and breaking versus sequential treatments
Warped, local LARGE-volume and fluxless regimes kept distinct
assumptions: Locality or spatial separation alone does not establish sequestering
Comparable mediation contributions and gauge dominance are different requirements
Visible soft masses and masses in a condensing stabilization sector are different targets
Historical spectrum forecasts are not current experimental validation
conventions: No common soft-term normalization or gravitino-mass prescription is imposed
excludes: A universal sequestering theorem or no-go
Automatic admission of pending anomalous-U(1), throat-response or vacuum-energy scopes

sources.title: SUSY Breaking in Local String/F-Theory Models

evidence.text: How strongly does bulk LARGE-volume supersymmetry breaking generate gravity and anomaly mediated soft terms on local Standard Model/GUT branes, and what follows for gauge mediation and the cosmological moduli problem?

sources.title: Warping and supersymmetry breaking

evidence.text: Can warping turn the high energy associated with an antibrane flux dual into a hierarchically small supersymmetry-breaking scale while maintaining a controlled, stabilized compactification?

sources.title: SUSY Breaking at the Tip of Throat and Mirage Mediation

evidence.text: Can infrared brane supersymmetry breaking generate viable ultraviolet visible soft terms when gauge-coupling moduli were first stabilized supersymmetrically by nonperturbative dynamics?

sources.title: SUSY Breaking at the Tip of Throat and Mirage Mediation

evidence.text: How do stabilization and localization determine the relative strengths of modulus and supergravity transmission of supersymmetry breaking, and therefore the visible soft masses?

sources.title: Classical and Quantum SUSY Breaking Effects in IIB Local Models

evidence.text: How do classical soft terms, flavor violation, Weyl-anomaly contributions and gaugino mediation constrain supersymmetry breaking in local type IIB Large Volume Scenario models?

sources.title: Anomalous U(1) Mediation in Large Volume Compactification

evidence.text: Does anomalous U(1)A mediation produce soft SUSY-breaking terms independent of detailed moduli mixing in LVS, and when do mixing-dependent F- and D-term contributions dominate the resulting MSSM spectrum?

sources.title: Superpotential de-sequestering in string models

evidence.text: When do geometrically distant moduli-stabilising effects or hidden scalar vevs induce visible-sector Yukawa couplings with new flavour structure, undermining sequestering and contributing to flavour violation?

sources.title: Sequestered de Sitter String Scenarios: Soft-terms

evidence.text: How do the de Sitter mechanism and subleading matter Kähler metric determine soft supersymmetry-breaking terms in sequestered LVS compactifications, including split and approximately common-scale MSSM spectra?

sources.title: Sequestered Conformal Anomaly Mediation (SCAM)

evidence.text: When does sequestered anomaly mediation derived in stabilized 5d supergravity reproduce the usual 4d prediction, and how do warping, boundary superpotentials and radion dynamics modify the required effective theory?

sources.title: Brane world SUSY breaking

evidence.text: Does physically separating visible matter and supersymmetry breaking on different branes enforce a sequestered Kähler potential, suppress tree-level scalar masses, and make anomaly mediation a generic solution to the supersymmetric flavor problem?

sources.title: Scales and hierarchies in warped compactifications and brane worlds

evidence.text: How do four-dimensional thresholds in warped brane compactifications depend on geometry versus supersymmetry-breaking dynamics, and can flux compactifications combine a warped hierarchy, heavy bulk fields, and light visible matter?

sources.title: Large-volume flux compactifications: Moduli spectrum and D3/D7 soft supersymmetry breaking

evidence.text: What moduli spectrum and D3/D7 soft supersymmetry-breaking terms follow after geometric-moduli stabilization with perturbative and nonperturbative corrections, and when is the four-dimensional effective description controlled?

sources.title: Soft SUSY Breaking Terms for Chiral Matter in IIB String Compactifications

evidence.text: How do chiral D7 matter metrics determine soft supersymmetry-breaking terms in stabilised IIB compactifications, particularly large-volume and single-modulus KKLT models, and under what conditions are those terms flavour-universal?

sources.title: Warped Supersymmetry Breaking

evidence.text: How does strong warping suppress supersymmetry breaking seen by matter deep in a throat, and under what scale hierarchies can that physics admit a 4D supergravity description, possibly supplemented by soft terms?

sources.title: Sequestering in String Theory

evidence.text: Can type IIB compactifications suppress flavor-violating hidden–visible supersymmetry-breaking couplings despite compactification moduli, and can strong warping provide robust sequestering suitable for flavor-blind mediation?

sources.title: Out of this world supersymmetry breaking

evidence.text: Can supersymmetry breaking away from the visible brane naturally suppress flavor-dependent soft terms while unavoidable anomaly-mediated contributions generate viable, predictive gaugino and scalar masses?

sources.title: Warping and supersymmetry breaking

evidence.text: Separate the UV boundary and localized interior terms by integration by parts. Compare complex structures at fixed flux labels, axio-dilaton, Kähler zero mode and geometric Λ0, allowing the nonconstant warp profile and tΛ to vary. Any fixed leading bulk normalization is a separate approximation.

sources.title: SUSY Breaking at the Tip of Throat and Mirage Mediation

evidence.text: Stabilize heavy fields, estimate their auxiliary components, eliminate fluctuations and insert their vacuum values into light couplings. Here S, U, X and Z are removed while the Goldstino, T and C remain.

sources.title: SUSY Breaking in Local String/F-Theory Models

evidence.text: Locality and volume independence of physical Yukawas are used as scaling arguments for Zα∼V^(−2/3). Matching the corrected bulk Kähler potential motivates α′³ as the first expected bulk-dependent matter-metric correction; its coefficient is not calculated.

sources.title: Classical and Quantum SUSY Breaking Effects in IIB Local Models

evidence.text: Expand the supergravity potential at large volume; compute moduli F-terms and matter-metric sectional curvatures; insert them into the supergravity soft-mass formula. The universal-mass calculation retains F^s contributions and subleading curvature terms important for its sign.

sources.title: Anomalous U(1) Mediation in Large Volume Compactification

evidence.text: Appendix A diagonalizes the component mass spectrum and evaluates its one-loop supertrace potential. The paper uses this calculation to identify the negative scalar threshold and match the cutoff-superfield dependence used in the superspace treatment.

sources.title: Superpotential de-sequestering in string models

evidence.text: Use worldsheet vertex operators, picture changing, H-charge conservation and spin-structure sums. Internal barred-field correlators receive classical winding contributions; Riemann theta identities reduce the remaining correlators.

sources.title: An M theory Solution to the Hierarchy Problem

evidence.text: Can strong hidden-sector gauge dynamics in fluxless G₂ compactifications stabilize moduli while generating the electroweak–Planck hierarchy, and what supersymmetry-breaking soft spectrum follows?

destination.title: Charged-state bounds on warped compactification scales
destination.question: In a Planck-brane compactification of AdS5 × X with a D3-brane U(1), what does applying the proposed electric charged-state mass bound to the stretched-string states imply for the volume of X as the warped direction becomes parametrically long at fixed relevant coupling?
destination.summary: The source obtains a conditional internal-volume bound. This provides a boundary test for warped hierarchy questions, with its conjectural premise and specific charged-state choice kept explicit.

systems: A Planck-brane compactification of AdS5 × X
A D3-brane U(1) with charged stretched strings
targets: Compatibility of a long warped direction with string-sized internal volume
The conditional relation between charged-string masses and gravitational scales
regimes: Fixed relevant string coupling in the volume comparison
assumptions: The stated warped compactification and brane sector exist
The displayed mass, gauge-coupling and Planck-scale scalings apply
The source applies its proposed electric bound to the charged stretched-string W states
The general conjecture asserts existence of suitable charged states, not an upper bound on every mass in every charge sector
conventions: V_X M_s^5 ≳ g_s(L_AdS M_s) is a parametric inequality
No precise coefficient or universal all-state inequality is inferred
excludes: An unconditional theorem of string consistency
A classification of all internal geometries
Proof from the absence of known counterexamples
